title: Lab - Kustomize components
description: Add an optional feature with a component.
scenario: Add an optional feature with a component. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Component
tasks.instructions: Create components/caching that adds a redis Deployment and patches the api to use it.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Enable
tasks.instructions: Enable the component only in the premium overlay.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Confirm
tasks.instructions: Confirm the standard overlay has no redis.
